lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular 2D distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the circular high-intensity blobs, defining a coordinate-like grid on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow values on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a commensal organism (remora) visible in the ventral region, positioned posterior to the fifth gill slit and ventral to the pectoral fin attachment.
